{{Quote|He’s still got my lucky coin.|Korlo Brightwater on Luke Skywalker|<ref name="COO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>}}
The '''druggat''' was one of the many forms of [[Currency/Legends|currency]] used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[Rise of the Empire era|final years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Fifty druggats was the deal made between the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] for the [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|T-14 hyperdrive generator]] when the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] carrying [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was stranded on Tatooine due to serious damage.

[[Korlo Brightwater]], a member of the renegade stormtroop group that called itself the [[Hand of Judgment]], carried one for luck which a grateful [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] had given to him . He lost it after he gave his [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] to the rebel[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="COO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The term "duggat" also sometimes appears.
